messages:
Sam P: quick handoff — taking off shift, handing to Ayesha R. main notes below.
Sam P: current dedicated GPU pool 'dedicated-prod-1' at ~78% util, steady for last 45m. no active incidents. :white_check_mark:
Sam P: watch for a scheduled customer batch from scribe_ai at ~12:10 UTC (they told SE it would start ~12:00). could briefly push util >95% for ~6-8m.
Sam P: burst capacity remaining: 2 GPUs (burst limit 4). autoscaler will only add up to burst limit; if we hit limit further scale needs infra assist.
Sam P: long-running jobs: job-3245 (retrain) starts at 11:50 UTC, expected 30m, nice to nudge offline if we see the spike.
Sam P: quick health checks I ran:
Sam P: ```
$ infractl pool status --pool=dedicated-prod-1
pool: dedicated-prod-1
active_gpus: 78
capacity_gpus: 100
burst_allocated: 2
burst_limit: 4
queued_requests_99pct_latency_ms: 190
```
Ayesha R: thanks — taking over. I bookmarked the scribe_ai contact in case they start earlier. will monitor dashboard + logs. :eyes:
Ayesha R: if we hit burst limit and latency climbs >250ms I’ll escalate to eng-infra. can you leave the escalation steps?
Sam P: yup — escalation notes in ops-runbook under section "burst escalation": pager eng-infra, DM @leo if no response in 5m, then open incident channel. also infra on-call Slack @infra-bot has an action to request extra quota (it files a ticket automatically).
Sam P: one more: console alert thresholds currently set to 85% pool util for a 5m window and 200ms 99pct token latency.
Leo: noted — I can be available for quick escalation this afternoon if needed. ping me in-thread and I’ll DM infra.
infra-bot: [AUTO] quota-request accepted: ticket #IQ-4521 created for temporary +4 GPUs for dedicated-prod-1. ETA for approval 12-25m.
Ayesha R: good to know. I’ll keep an eye on queue depth and KV cache hit rate (low hit rate = more compute).
Ayesha R: small FYI — api-prod route /v1/generate has seen a ~10% increase in traffic last hour, likely from feature flag rollouts. not expected to be sustained but mention in case.
Sam P: thanks. leaving the thread in your hands @Ayesha R. I’ll be offline in ~10m. :wave:
Ayesha R: thanks Sam, taking it. will post an update if we hit >90% util or if infra-bot returns approval.
Leo: ping me if ticked to escalate, otherwise I’ll check in at 12:30 UTC.
Ayesha R: update 12:12 UTC — scribe_ai batch started, util peaked 92% for ~3m, burst used 2/4, latency stayed ~210ms 99pct. infra-bot ticket still pending.
Ayesha R: update 12:33 UTC — batch finished, util back to 70%. no action needed. logging results to handoff notes. :thumbsup:
